title: Public profile
summary: Turns the user's public profile on or off and edits its name, bio and photo. Anyone with the link bipe.chat/@handle sees it; it is not in any search (ADR 0041).

handle.description: MyProfile.handle. Without it the switch is off and locked: bipe_public_profile_needs_handle.

name.description: MyProfile.name. A profile never saved starts with the Matrix display name.

photoUrl.description: MyProfile.photo_url, or a local file URL of a newly picked photo. A profile never saved offers the Matrix photo.

problem.description: From profileProblem: bipe_public_profile_name_empty, bipe_public_profile_name_too_long (nameMaxLength), bipe_app_profile_name_reserved, bipe_public_profile_bio_too_long (bioMaxLength), bipe_public_profile_bio_too_many_lines (bioMaxLines). Save is off unless none.

phase.description: saved: bipe_public_profile_saved. failed: bipe_error_network, or the problem the server returned (ProfileProblem).

setEnabled.effect: Updates enabled. Saved with the rest.

choosePhoto.effect: Opens the system photo picker, then a square crop.

save.effect: PUT /v1/me/profile with enabled, name and bio (trimmed). A new photo: PUT /v1/me/profile/photo with the JPEG (see notes). Then bipe_public_profile_saved.

notes: Opens from the publicProfile row of Seu perfil (settings-group profile). The row value is bipe_public_profile_on or bipe_public_profile_off.

Separate from the Matrix profile (ADR 0041): changing this name or photo does not change profile-edit, and the other way round. The first time, the app fills the fields from the Matrix profile (Client.displayName, and Client.getMediaContent for the photo).

Rules: registries/profiles.json (nameMaxLength 50, bioMaxLength 160, bioMaxLines 4, photoMaxBytes, photoMaxPixels) and the reserved names, by profileProblem in tools/lib/registries.mjs. The server is the authority and returns the same ProfileProblem ids. Bipe logic: BipePublicProfileRules and BipeProfilePhoto.jpegData (BipeKit BipePublicProfile.swift); BipePublicProfile.kt (libraries/bipe).

Photo: JPEG only, at most photoMaxPixels on each side and photoMaxBytes. The app re-encodes; the server strips every metadata segment. A photo the app cannot encode: bipe_public_profile_photo_invalid.
Without a handle: the switch is locked, bipe_public_profile_needs_handle shows with bipe_handle_prompt_action, which opens handle-pick.
Turning it off hides the profile at once: GET /v1/profiles/{handle} answers 404, the same as for an unknown handle.
